mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (recipient_id, sender_id, type, resource_type, resource_id) VALUES (#{recipientId}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId})
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.recipient_id, n.sender_id, u.name AS sender_name, u.profile_image_url AS sender_profile_image_url, n.type, n.resource_type, n.resource_id, n.is_read, n.created_at FROM notifications n LEFT JOIN users u ON n.sender_id = u.id WHERE n.recipient_id = #{recipientId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = true WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = false
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND is_read = false
